title: Wicket
kicker: a Hexmart pocket-ward vendor with too many charm strings
hook: a Hexmart pocket-ward vendor with too many charm strings

blocks.label: Public Read
blocks.body: A beaming halfling peddler presents a tray of blue charms, brass rings, and useless-but-beautiful pocket wards with both hands and all their hope.

blocks.label: Comes Across As
blocks.body: All flourish and warmth on top, frantic arithmetic underneath. Compliments you, then names the price, then the problem, in that order, every time. He believes the pitch because the alternative is unbearable.

blocks.label: Might Offer
blocks.body: A way forward A grounded question A scene-specific clue seed
